why: This is the broad, generic "best portable power station" query and the results are stacked with major reviewers answering it with their own testing: Consumer Reports lab tests, TechRadar (50+ units tested), OutdoorGearLab (14 units bought and tested), plus Bob Vila with a tested roundup. Two bench-tested niche pages and a hands-on affiliate outlet fill the remaining slots. A new Dealectric page would be fighting three to four major testers on their home turf; only a narrower angle (live prices, codes, a specific budget or use case) could realistically get in.
